master.definition_en: Formation or presence of a blood clot (thrombus) in the lateral sinuses. This condition is often associated with ear infections (otitis media or mastoiditis) without antibiotic treatment. In developed nations, lateral sinus thrombosis can result from craniocerebral trauma; brain neoplasms; neurosurgical procedures; thrombophilia; and other conditions. Clinical features include headache; vertigo; and increased intracranial pressure.

master.definition_en: A major psychotic disorder characterized by abnormalities in the perception or expression of reality. It affects the cognitive and psychomotor functions. Common clinical signs and symptoms include delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and retreat from reality.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 高度异质性慢性精神病性障碍，虽非直接器官坏死，但因自杀风险（约5%终生自杀死亡）、长期抗精神病药代谢异常所致心血管疾病、肺部感染及照护缺位，患者总体预期寿命较普通人群缩短10–20年。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 一代及二代多巴胺/5-HT受体拮抗剂可良好控制幻觉、妄想等阳性症状，长效针剂显著改善复发率；但对阴性症状（情感淡漠、意志减退）与认知缺损及约20%–30%难治性患者疗效有限。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD与WHO未将精神分裂症直接列为死亡原因代码（相关死亡归入心血管、代谢、感染及自杀条目）；WHO明确指出患者死亡风险为一般人群2–3倍，预期寿命缩短10–20年

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国官方死因统计不将精神分裂症计入直接死因绝对人数；是国家严重精神障碍综合管理核心在册病种，早死主要来自共病与意外/自杀

epidemiology.prevalence_global: WHO估计全球约1/300人（约2,400万–2,700万；GBD 2021直接建模约2,318万–2,360万例）

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性精神病性兴奋激越、自伤/伤人危机或恶性综合征(NMS)急救：(1) 环境降级减压与保护性约束；(2) 急性重度激越肌注氟哌啶醇、奥氮平或齐拉西酮联合苯二氮䓬类；(3) 若发生罕见致命的抗精神病药恶性综合征(高热、肌强直、CK骤升)，立即停用抗精神病药、ICU补液降温并予溴隐亭或丹曲林抢救；(4) 难治紧张症/木僵予急诊MECT。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: FDA于2024年9月批准全新非多巴胺D2靶点药物Cobenfy（KarXT，M1/M4毒蕈碱受体激动剂混合外周拮抗剂），成为数十年来首个突破传统D2机制的抗精神病药，可避免锥体外系反应及显著体重升高，国内多家药企亦在推进同类毒蕈碱M1/M4与TAAR1激动剂临床试验。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 长期阴性症状与认知损伤目前尚无国批特效药物；约30%患者对D2阻断剂应答不佳；社会病耻感及社区康复依从性断档仍是致残主因。

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 本身极少直接致死（GBD归类为非致死性致残病种），但长期尿酸盐结晶沉积可致剧痛性急性关节炎反复发作、痛风石形成及骨关节毁损，引起尿酸性肾结石、慢性痛风性肾病甚至进展为终末期肾衰，并显著增加冠心病与慢性肾病全因死亡风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 属高度可控代谢病；急性期采用秋水仙碱、NSAIDs或激素/抗IL-1β单抗快速镇痛消炎，缓解期通过别嘌醇、非布司他或苯溴马隆长期达标降尿酸（血尿酸控制<360或<300 μmol/L）并配合饮食体重管理，可完全预防复发并逐步溶解痛风石。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021将痛风归类为非致死性疾病（无独立归因死亡总数）；2021年全球痛风导致约175万伤残调整生命年（DALYs），主要源于剧烈疼痛与关节功能障碍

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 无独立致死计数；GBD 2021数据显示中国痛风疾病负担中约31.4%的DALYs归因于高BMI肥胖危险因素

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算全球痛风现患人数约5,700万例，年新发约940万例，全球患病呈显著年轻化与上升趋势。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 国家卫健委《成人高尿酸血症与痛风食养指南（2024年版）》引用调查显示，中国成人高尿酸血症患病率约14%（患者近2亿），痛风患病率为1.1%-3.2%，男性患病率高于女性2.8倍以上，年轻化趋势突出。

research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中国人群长期规范降尿酸达标率及依从性极低（大量患者仅发作期止痛、疼痛缓解即停药，导致痛风石与痛风性肾病进展）；2) 中国汉族高携带率的HLA-B*5801致死性超敏反应基因筛查普及不充分；3) 合并重度慢性肾病（eGFR<30）患者的降尿酸用药选择高度受限。

master.definition_en: A rare skin disease characterized by widespread cutaneous telangiectases usually ﬁrst appearing on the lower limbs and slowly progressing upwards to involve the trunk and arms. The lesions can be diffuse, localized, macular, plaque-like, discrete, or conﬂuent. Recurrent bleeding from the skin and mucous membranes is not a common feature. Likewise, co-existing epidermal or dermal abnormalities, like atrophy, depigmentation, or purpura, are absent. The condition is non-hereditary, and to establish the diagnosis, other primary and secondary telangiectases must be excluded.

master.definition_en: Perioral myoclonia with absences is a rare epilepsy syndrome characterized by absence seizures with perioral myoclonia as the main seizure type, accompanied by generalized tonic-clonic seizures, appearing before or together with absences. Commonly observed absence status epilepticus, poor response to antiepileptic drugs and persistence of seizures into adulthood, in the presence of normal neurological status and intelligence, are additional clinical features of this syndrome.

master.name_en: Cockayne spectrum with or without cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome
master.definition_en: An autosomal recessive, multisystem condition caused by pathogenic variants of the ERCC6 gene, encoding the DNA excision repair protein, ERCC-6. Cockayne spectrum with or without cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome is characterized by growth failure at birth, with little or no postnatal neurologic development in addition to congenital cataracts or other structural anomalies of the eye, early postnatal contractures of the spine (kyphosis, scoliosis) and joints, and death usually occurring by age five years. This term lumps Cockayne syndrome type 2/B (CSB), cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome 1 (COFS syndrome), and De Sanctis-Cacchione syndrome into a spectrum of disease.

master.definition_en: Any skeletal dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the TRIP11 gene. Reduced protein function in TRIP11 causes a spectrum of skeletal symptoms from a more mild phenotype, called ondontochondrodysplasia, with features including short stature and joint laxity to a more severe phenotype, called achondrogenesis type 1A, which presents as a lethal prenatal or neonatal skeletal dysplasia. The clinical severity of achondrogenesis compared to ondontochondrodysplasia is related to the residual function of the gene which is not currently possible to anticipate based on genotype alone. The phenotype cannot fully be predicted by genotype alone, evidenced by variants being reported with both phenotypes.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
